capture_notes: Recorded WAN captures were used for masN, minN because no LAN captures were recorded. These observe traffic crossing the router, not LAN-local traffic; timing and loss can differ across the router. See provenance.json for the interface used in each trial.
sample_unit: one cumulative network-vantage measurement per trial
dns_size: UDP payload bytes; TCP DNS size is unavailable in this extractor
limitations: Physical packetization, headers, retransmissions and timing differ from SMC abstractions.
New TCP connections count distinct observed SYN-without-ACK streams.
Legacy capture filenames provide second-resolution UTC start times, not readiness barriers.

excluded_trials.reason: Capture shorter than the required 600-second window; no padding or partial-window sample used.

notes: HCS-only packet-capture features. No matched control arm was run; KS distances, p-values and confidentiality decisions are unavailable.
The 600-second window starts at capture_metadata.start_epoch, matching the existing confidentiality extractor; it includes startup traffic and is not aligned to the first IRC message.
cl[1] is the only client network in this configuration: client_net_mastodon. Client indices are configuration-local; use vantage_networks when comparing other suites.
Diagnostic 10-second bins are not independent trial samples. TCP sizes and byte rates use captured frame bytes; DNS sizes use UDP payload bytes.
Excluded trial 005: Capture shorter than the required 600-second window; no padding or partial-window sample used. Recorded duration: 333.308s.
